title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_die_kinder_vom_arbat_by_anatolij_rybakow_eqqz5 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_die_kinder_vom_arbat_by_anatolij_rybakow_eqqz5' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Installation of this package potentially grants full control of the affected system to an outside entity. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to the extent of compromise, all secrets and keys stored on the machine should be rotated from a different, secure computer. There is no guarantee that removing the package will eliminate all malicious software introduced by it.
